headline: Performance Marketing | Affiliate Strategy | Funnel Optimization
headline_rationale: This healthcare acquisition role prioritizes channel diversification, affiliate economics, testing and downstream outcomes. Select verified cross-channel, affiliate and incremental measurement facts without claiming patient acquisition, LegitScript or healthcare compliance expertise.
summary: Performance marketer combining paid search, social and affiliate strategy with disciplined funnel analysis. Evaluated incremental CPA, lifetime value, affiliate commissions and promotion economics, and developed affiliate-program strategy and digital creative. Managed multichannel budgets, led an eight-person e-commerce team, and partnered with web teams on conversion performance. Brings structured experimentation, automated reporting and agency evaluation experience to judging acquisition quality and deciding where additional marketing investment can produce sustainable growth.
factual_review: Read exact Jobgether Manager Performance Marketing posting. Supported E002/E004/E102/E030/E093/E095/E006/E009/E011. No patient/member acquisition results, Reddit/programmatic/audio ownership, LegitScript, EKRA or Anti-Kickback expertise claimed.
tools_rationale: Actual supported acquisition and measurement tools relevant to diversified campaign execution and funnel evaluation.
